Dave Matthews Band
August 24, 2024
Fiddler's Green Amphitheatre - Greenwood Village, CO

*=*=*=*=*=* *=*=*=*=*=* *=*=*=*=*=*
*=*=*=*=* 16/48 RECORDING *=*=*=*=*
*=* NOT SUITABLE FOR CD BURNING *=*
*=*=*=*=*=* *=*=*=*=*=* *=*=*=*=*=*

Taper: Zachary Semcken
Source: AKG C414 XLII (Hypercardioid) > MixPre 10 II (32 Bit Float @ 96)
Location: Rear House Right of FOH, DFC, Mics PAS @ 13'
Editing: WAV > Reaper 7.22 (Gain, Mixing, Normalizing, Resample 24/48) > Audacity 3.6.2 (Fades, Tracking) > FLAC (Level 8)

Setlist:

04. Spoon
05. Virginia in the Rain²
06. Sweet
07. Can't Stop
08. Monsters
09. Sugar Will
10. Crash Into Me³
11. Lying in the Hands of God >
12. American Baby Intro >
13. Break Free
14. Lie in Our Graves⁴
15. Band Introductions
16. Spaceman
17. #27
18. The Space Between
19. Typical Situation
20. Anyone Seen the Bridge⁵ >
21. Too Much
22. Encore Break
23. Just Breathe⁶
24. Grey Street

Set Time: [02:33:20.675]

Dave Matthews Band:

Dave Matthews - Guitar, Lead Vocals
Tim Reynolds - Electric Guitar
Stefan Lessard - Bass
Buddy Strong - Keyboards, Vocals
Rashawn Ross - Trumpet, Vocals
Jeff Coffin - Saxophone, Flute
Carter Beauford - Drums

Notes:

¹ direct intro; Shake Your Body (Down to the Ground) interpolation
² jazz outro
³ Dixie Chicken interpolation
⁴ Wonderful Tonight interpolation
⁵ Also Sprach Zarathustra and Heartbreaker interpolations
⁶ Pearl Jam cover, Dave Solo

Between "Typical Situation" and "Anyone Seen the Bridge", Rashawn teases "The James Bond Theme".

Huge thanks to the entire DMB organization for supporting live taping.

This recording is dedicated to all the tapers that have taught me to love archiving live music.

Compiled on 2024/09/06.
